title: 第34章 洞中夜话第36章 遮风挡雨
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
赵宇傻傻站在一边，看着南宫秋月一边抽搐，一边哭泣，心中也很难受，但又不知如何去安慰，说起来他还是个少年。
他等着南宫秋月哭泣完，慢慢平缓下来，上前一步弱弱地问道：“南宫小姐，是不是我惹你生气了？不好意思我回来晚了，让你受惊吓了，我在那边也碰到了妖兽，对不起！”
南宫秋月看着赵宇的样子，真正的五味杂陈：又喜、又气、又爱、又恼、又心痛。
真想上去狠狠咬他一口！
赵宇看着南宫秋月满脸泪水，就自然地想把那块布条递给她，想让她擦擦泪水。
又一想她现在手脚不便，又小声开口道：“你手脚有伤不方便擦，要不我帮你擦可好？”
南宫秋月本来想耍一下小性子，又一看那傻小子惶恐不安的样子，就于心不忍，点点头：“好，谢谢你！”
赵宇赶忙心慌手乱地给南宫秋月擦去泪水，终于长喘了一口气，又过了片刻，说道：“我在那边找了一个地方，是一个山洞，那里比较安全，要不我扶你过去？”
南宫秋月点了点头：“好，真辛苦你了。”
赵宇上前拉着南宫秋月的手，准备扶她过去。
南宫秋月刚走两步，便痛得呲牙咧嘴，赵宇赶忙停了下来，不知怎么处理了。
一看扶着走肯定不行，这段路说长也不短，要么背着，又想到南宫秋月身前还有几道伤口呢。
那只有托在手里了。
赵宇有些忐忑地问道：“要不我用手托着你过去吧，好不好？”
南宫秋月一听一阵脸红，还是点头称好。
南宫秋月像一个小孩般被赵宇用双臂托着，她故意眯着眼看着赵宇，有些话一直想问问赵宇，又看着赵宇托着她行走应该很累，所以只能先闭口不言。
赵宇对她来说有很多的疑问：明明自己被妖兽抓伤，又中了很深的毒，几乎是不可救药的，偏偏赵宇把她救了回来。
刚才那群妖兽明明已把她团团围住，可无论如何也近不了她的身，像是被一道无形的围墙给挡住了。
赵宇的境界明显很低，而对着一群二阶三阶的妖狼，好像很轻松地都给宰杀了，就算现在自己境界已经到了超凡境，就算没有受伤也不可能轻松地宰杀那群妖狼，最多也就能脱身。
现在她很后悔，刚才闭什么眼，睁眼看着搏杀妖兽不知有多精彩！

还有他的家，他的父母等等？
……
她想着想着，就见赵宇半抱半托着她进了一个山洞，又把她放到了一张兽皮上，赵宇虽体质异常，但要托着一个人走那么远的山路还是挺累的，她把南宫秋月放到那张自己一直没扔掉的虎皮上，伸手擦了擦汗，心中大定，今晚终于可以有个安身之所了，他倒不是怕自己有什么，反正他在山里野外都习惯了。
主要是南宫秋月本是个女孩子，又受了重伤。
南宫秋月躺在虎皮上，感到从所未有的舒服，比以前那些装潢考究的高档房间都要舒服很多很多，赵宇还用树干给她做了枕头，上面有皮子垫着也很舒服，她朝四周看看，山洞中真有一只很大的已被宰杀的黑熊，应该就是赵宇所说的那只妖兽了。
她正想向赵宇问问那些她憋了好一会的问题。
content_en:
Zhao Yu stood aside stupidly, watching Nangong Qiuyue twitching and crying. He felt very sad, but he didn't know how to comfort her. Speaking of which, he was still a teenager.
He waited for Nangong Qiuyue to finish crying and slowly calmed down. He took a step forward and asked weakly: "Miss Nangong, did I make you angry? I'm sorry that I came back late and frightened you. I also encountered a monster over there. I'm sorry!"
Nangong Qiuyue looked at Zhao Yu with a mixture of emotions: happy, angry, loving, annoyed, and heartbroken.
I really want to go up and bite him hard!
Zhao Yu saw Nangong Qiuyue's face full of tears, and naturally wanted to hand her the piece of cloth to wipe her tears.
Then he thought that her hands and feet were inconvenient now, so he whispered again: "Your hands and feet are injured and it's hard to wipe them. How about I help you wipe them?"
Nangong Qiuyue originally wanted to be a little playful, but when she saw the silly boy's frightened look, she couldn't bear it and nodded: "Okay, thank you!"
Zhao Yu hurriedly wiped away Nangong Qiuyue's tears in a panic, and finally took a long breath. After a while, he said, "I found a place over there, a cave. It's safer there. How about I help you there?"
Nangong Qiuyue nodded: "Okay, thank you for your hard work."
Zhao Yu stepped forward and took Nangong Qiuyue's hand, preparing to help her over.
Nangong Qiuyue had just taken two steps when she grimaced in pain. Zhao Yu stopped quickly, not knowing how to deal with it.
At first glance, it was definitely not possible to walk with support. The journey was not short, so it was necessary to carry it on her back. She also thought of how many wounds Nangong Qiuyue had in front of her body.
It can only be held in your hands.
Zhao Yu asked with some anxiety: "How about I carry you over with my hands, okay?"
Nangong Qiuyue blushed when she heard this, but nodded in agreement.
Nangong Qiuyue was supported by Zhao Yu's arms like a child. She deliberately squinted at Zhao Yu. There were some things she always wanted to ask Zhao Yu. She also looked at Zhao Yu who should be very tired while holding her while walking, so she could only keep silent for now.
Zhao Yu had a lot of questions for her: She was clearly scratched by a monster and poisoned so deeply that she was almost incurable, yet Zhao Yu saved her.
The group of monsters just now had obviously surrounded her, but they couldn't get close to her no matter what, as if they were blocked by an invisible wall.
Zhao Yu's realm was obviously very low, and he seemed to kill a group of second- and third-order demon wolves easily. Even if his realm had reached the extraordinary realm now, even if he was not injured, he would not be able to easily kill those group of demon wolves. At most, he would be able to escape.
Now she regretted that she had closed her eyes just now, but it was so exciting to open her eyes and watch the monsters being fought!
And his home, his parents, etc.?
…
As she was thinking about it, she saw Zhao Yu half-carrying and half-carrying her into a cave, and then placed her on an animal skin. Although Zhao Yu had an abnormal physique, it was still tiring to carry someone on such a long mountain road. She placed Nangong Qiuyue on the tiger skin that she had never thrown away, and reached out to wipe the sweat. She was convinced that she would finally have a place to stay tonight. It was not that he was afraid of anything, he was used to being in the mountains and the wild anyway.
The main reason is that Nangong Qiuyue was a girl and was seriously injured.
Lying on the tiger skin, Nangong Qiuyue felt more comfortable than ever before. It was much more comfortable than the well-decorated high-end rooms before. Zhao Yu also made her a pillow with a tree trunk, which was also very comfortable with the leather cushion on it. She looked around and saw that there was really a large slaughtered black bear in the cave. It should be the monster that Zhao Yu mentioned.
She was about to ask Zhao Yu the questions she had been holding back for a while.
